description: The hard >=50 star cut (run.sh:102, `if int(r.get('stargazerCount',0)) < 50: continue`) is a proxy for 'real funded project' that false-negatives real small-org bounties. Algora is used by early-stage startups and solo maintainers who post genuine $100-500 USD bounties on repos with well under 50 stars. Star count is not correlated with whether a Stripe-backed reward is attached. The correct signal — does algora-pbc actually report a USD reward on the issue — is never queried. This rule will discard a class of legitimately payable bounties.
